Sandbox_PivotMod_Enabled_tooltip: Master switch for the whole mod. When OFF, turning is left completely vanilla.
Sandbox_PivotMod_PivotSpeed_tooltip:
Only used when 'Use Nimble-based turning' is OFF.
How fast the character turns to the aim direction while in the combat stance.
The scale runs from Vanilla up to Instant; 'Instant' is as fast as the turn can go while staying smooth. The in-between steps let you pick a gentler, more gradual turn.
Sandbox_PivotMod_MovementTurnSpeed_toolt:
Only used when 'Use Nimble-based turning' is OFF.
How fast the character turns while walking (not aiming). Jogging and sprinting always turn at vanilla speed - the engine doesn't let mods change those.
The scale runs from Vanilla up to Instant; the in-between steps let you pick a gentler turn.
Sandbox_PivotMod_NimbleSystem_tooltip:
Switches the entire mod between two systems.
OFF: the fixed turn speeds set above - separate values for aiming and walking.
ON: turn speed instead scales with the Nimble skill and the multipliers below, applied to ALL turning.
Sandbox_PivotMod_NimbleLvlMultiplier_too: Nimble-based turning only. A final multiplier applied on top of the computed turn speed. 1 = no extra change.
Sandbox_PivotMod_DefaultMultiplier_toolt: Nimble-based turning only. Starting turn-speed multiplier before the Nimble skill scaling is added. 1 = vanilla turn speed.
Sandbox_PivotMod_DynamicModifiers_toolti: Master switch for the situational modifiers below. When OFF, none of them do anything and turning behaves exactly as set above. When ON, each modifier you enable adjusts your walking/aiming turn speed based on your character's current condition. Works with both the fixed-speed and Nimble-based systems. Turning is never fully locked, and never pushed past the smooth cap.
Sandbox_PivotMod_DynEncumbrance_tooltip: Requires the master switch. The heavier your carried weight relative to your max, the slower you turn - a full load turns at roughly half speed. Pairs naturally with Strength.
Sandbox_PivotMod_DynInjury_tooltip: Requires the master switch. Wounds to the legs, feet or groin slow your turn; the worst affected part dominates, and a fracture there slows it much more.
Sandbox_PivotMod_DynFatigue_tooltip: Requires the master switch. Being tired, or out of breath (low endurance), makes turning sluggish; well-rested and fresh turns are snappy.
Sandbox_PivotMod_DynDrunkenness_tooltip: Requires the master switch. The more intoxicated you are, the slower and clumsier your turn.
Sandbox_PivotMod_DynPanic_tooltip: Requires the master switch. Panic makes you whip around faster - up to about +50%% turn speed at full panic (still capped to stay smooth).
Sandbox_PivotMod_DynSneak_tooltip: Requires the master switch. While sneaking you turn more slowly and deliberately (about 70%% speed).
